title: Extraction of high molecular weight insect DNA for long-read sequencing
author: Berenice J. Lafon
materials: If the DNA forms a pellet:
Gently mix by inverting the tube.
If a DNA pellet is not present:
If the DNA pellet does not dissolve completely (presence of fat or protein), incubate at 37°C for 30 minutes with minimal agitation (Thermomixer).
Leave it overnight at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare tissue according to preservation
steps.instruction: Process the specimen based on its preservation: (a) RNAlater – pour contents into a Petri dish, blot onto a sterile pad, wash tissue in 1 mL PBS, blot again, then place in mortar; (b) ethanol – pour contents into a Petri dish, blot onto a sterile pad, then place in mortar; (c) live or frozen at –80 °C – dissect in absolute ethanol, blot lightly, cut into small pieces on a sterile compress, then place in mortar. Select tissues avoiding cuticle, bristles, gut, defensive glands, and eggs; prioritize muscle and tracheae.

steps.title: Add lysis buffer to tissue
steps.instruction: Place 500 µL ATL lysis buffer (Qiagen DNeasy Blood & Tissue Kit, containing EDTA and SDS) into the mortar containing the tissue.

steps.title: Grind tissue to homogenous slurry
steps.instruction: Grind with a pestle for a few minutes until the tissue is well crushed.

steps.title: Transfer crushed tissue to tube
steps.instruction: Recover all crushed material with a P1000 pipette (cut tip if needed) and transfer to a 2 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Add Proteinase K
steps.instruction: Add Proteinase K (from the Qiagen kit) at 10 % of the buffer volume (e.g., 50 µL to 500 µL buffer).

steps.title: Adjust lysis volume
steps.instruction: Add additional lysis buffer as required so that the tissue is completely submerged.

steps.title: Mix gently
steps.instruction: Swirl the tube gently to mix; do not vortex.

steps.title: Add RNase A
steps.instruction: Add RNase A at 4 µL per 200 µL total volume (e.g., 11 µL for 550 µL).

substeps.instruction: Add RNase A at the calculated volume.
Swirl gently to mix.
Centrifuge for ≤3 seconds.

steps.title: Pellet tissue debris
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 11,000 g for 10 minutes at room temperature to pellet remaining tissue.

steps.title: Collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a fresh 2 mL tube, avoiding any floating fat layer. Pipet in 100 µL increments to determine final volume (aim for 450–500 µL).

steps.title: Digest at 56 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate at 56 °C in a ThermoMixer (300 rpm, agitation optional) for 1–2 hours, monitoring digestion progress.

steps.title: Split large volumes
steps.instruction: If the supernatant volume exceeds 600 µL, divide it equally into two tubes.

steps.title: Add sodium acetate
steps.instruction: Add 3 M sodium acetate to 10 % of the supernatant volume (e.g., 50 µL for 500 µL) and swirl gently.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with ethanol
steps.instruction: Add absolute ethanol equal to twice the supernatant volume (e.g., 1,000 µL for 500 µL) and invert the tube ~20 times until a DNA pellet forms.

steps.title: First 70 % ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Wash the DNA pellet with 70 % ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the pellet to a 1.5 mL tube containing 1 mL 70 % ethanol.
Aspirate the supernatant with a P1000 cone without disturbing the pellet.
Remove remaining ethanol by gentle pipetting without aspirating the pellet.

steps.title: Second 70 % ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Repeat the previous wash with fresh 1 mL 70 % ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Perform the same aspiration and removal steps as in the first wash.

steps.title: Remove residual ethanol
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube for ≤3 seconds and use a P10 pipette to remove any remaining ethanol without aspirating the pellet.

steps.title: Air‑dry pellet
steps.instruction: Leave the tube open for 5 minutes to allow residual ethanol to evaporate.

steps.title: Final ethanol wash and pellet
steps.instruction: Perform a final ethanol wash and re‑pellet the DNA.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 11,000 g for 10 minutes to pellet DNA.
Pipette off the supernatant.
Add 1 mL 70 % ethanol, tap to resuspend the pellet.
Remove ethanol and repeat the wash once more.
Remove ethanol by pipetting without aspirating the pellet.
Centrifuge for ≤3 seconds.
Remove remaining ethanol with a P10 pipette.

steps.title: Dry and resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Air‑dry briefly, then resuspend the DNA pellet in 100–200 µL nuclease‑free water (volume based on pellet size).

steps.title: Optional impurity removal
steps.instruction: If impurities remain, further clean the DNA.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the resuspended DNA at 11,000 g for 5 minutes.
Collect the supernatant while avoiding any fat layer.
Transfer the cleared supernatant to a new 1.5 mL tube.

steps.title: Quantify DNA
steps.instruction: Perform a Qubit Broad‑Range DNA assay (and optionally a Nanodrop measurement).

steps.title: Assess fragment size
steps.instruction: Run a 1 % agarose gel; a high‑molecular‑weight band >10 kb should be visible, with minimal RNA bands (<200 bp).

steps.title: Purify with AMPure beads
steps.instruction: Purify the DNA using 1× AMPure XP beads and re‑measure concentration.

substeps.instruction: Perform purification with 1× AMPure XP beads.
Run Qubit Broad‑Range assay on the purified DNA.
Measure absorbance with a Nanodrop spectrophotometer.
